name: Bennett University Online

about.text: The university’s online programs are flexible, accessible, and give an opportunity to develop into careers across India and beyond. In 2016, The Times Group, a reputable media company with over 185 years, founded Bennett University. To take the Indian higher education ecosystem up a notch with innovative education, technology, and entrepreneurship-based approaches, the university was created. Located in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, Bennett University is considered one of the premier private universities in the country since its inception.

In addition to undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and online degrees, it offers courses in management, engineering, media, law, design, artificial intelligence, and liberal arts. The Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) here focuses on high-quality online education through an online platform by Bennett Online. UGC-entitled and nationally recognized and NEP-compliant online courses legitimize and give the programs national recognition and credibility amongst a large and diverse population. Currently, Bennett Online teaches online MBA and Online BBA programs with specialization based on the trend of the industry, such as Finance, Marketing, HRM, Business Analytics, and Logistics & Supply Chain Management. Offers live, video-recorded lectures, digital learning materials, online assessments, academic assistance, and specialised student services.

The university offers experiential learning, industry projects, and mentorship and training for the workforce. It collaborates with corporate collaborators and recruiters to provide internships and placements. Students have a digital infrastructure, an AI-enabled learning ecosystem, and a flexible learning timetable that would ensure working professionals can pursue studies without interrupting their jobs. A notable online university in India is Bennett University.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: Bennett University has flexible fee submission as well as no-cost EMI facilities for students attending online programs. The Online BBA program fee is about ₹25,000 per semester, while the Online MBA fee is about ₹52,500 per semester. Students can select semester-wise payment options to minimize cost. Defence personnel, Bennett alumni, and differently-abled learners will also benefit from scholarship benefits. EMI facilities ensure that working professionals and students can continue to study at higher education without paying the full fee upfront. Additional charges may apply for examinations, re-registration, or payment gateway services.

admission.text: The admission process of online degree programs at Bennett University is simple, transparent, and 100% online.
Step 1: Students would be able to apply via the Bennett Online Admission Portal by filling out the application form online and providing the appropriate paperwork.

Step 2: Class 12 (minimum qualifying percentage) is required for Online BBA admissions. Most need a minimum of 50% marks from a recognized university for their bachelor’s degree for Online MBA admissions.
Step 3: For professionals, as well as candidates new to studying, one can apply, as well, for online programs.
Step 4: Uploading academic documents, identification, and a passport-size photograph. Payment of the application fee.
Step 5: Checking documentation by the admissions committee.
Step 6: Payments for registering for a semester or annual enrollment. Admission verification and entrance to the student learning portal.
Step 7: Students are provided their login, student ID, and orientation contact information after enrollment.
Similar to other schools, Bennett University also provides counseling support, explaining the eligibility, specialization, fee structure, and career opportunities for new students.

At Bennett University, the college carries forward a learner-friendly admission policy that includes payment methods and financial aid. Moreover, it even hosts EMI support to guarantee good, cost-effective enrollment.

examination.text: Bennett University’s examination system is intended to assess both conceptual understanding and practical application. Students are assessed through assignments, quizzes, projects, case studies, and semester-end examinations. The structure of the online programs is typically semester-based with continuous evaluation throughout the academic session. Examinations are conducted online based on university rules. Students need to maintain academic performance through assignments and participation in learning activities. The curriculum promotes students’ skills development and industry-specific projects, practical experience, and skill-based assessments with industry-relevant projects such as internships or other project-based skill-based tests that will contribute to increasing employability and preparedness for the workplace.

Three mandatory components: (1) Formative (Continuous) Assessment = 30% weightage, (2) Summative (End Term) Assessment = 70% weightage. Summative exam = 2.5 hours, structured as 40% MCQs + 30% Descriptive Questions. Two formats: Centre-based (at BU campus) OR Remote Online Proctored Exam ("At my location" option). Minimum 40% aggregate required to pass. 75% engagement/attendance required.

placementText.text: Bennett University offers placement and career support at Bennett University. This includes business cooperation, job services, career advice, peer training and speaking with employers. The university is associated with corporations like Google, Amazon Web Services, Cisco, Dell, Coca-Cola, Capgemini and BNY Mellon and the like. Students are assisted in researching résumés, interviewing candidates, and scheduling career counseling appointments and industry consult sessions. The bachelor's program focuses on employability competency and professional skills, as well as on industrial-style training and experiential learning. There are some placement options, depending on students’ performance and specialization and current market conditions.

faculty.name: Prof. (Dr.) Nidhi Sinha
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.description: Dr. Nidhi Sinha has more than 20 years of rich experience in teaching, research, and training. She is an Associate Professor of Marketing and Communication in the School of Management at Bennett University. She specializes in the areas of Brand Management, Marketing Communication, Internet and Digital Marketing, and Social Media Marketing.

faculty.name: Dr. Monika Sharma
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.description: Dr. Monika Sharma’s accomplishments are highlighted by securing an Indian Patent for an innovative system aimed at preventing real-time accidents. She earned her Ph.D. from the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, highlighting her deep expertise in the field.

faculty.name: Dr. Pratibha Biswas
faculty.title: Assistant Professor
faculty.description: Dr. Pratibha has a decade worth of experience in teaching English Language, Literature and Communication to undergraduate and graduate students. She earned her MPhil and PhD from the Department of English, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi.

faculty.name: Prof. (Dr.) Bhuwandeep
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.description: Dr. Bhuwandeep is an Associate Professor at the School of Management, Bennett University. His academic journey began with a B.Tech (Hons.) from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, followed by an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore.

faculty.name: Prof. (Dr.) Ruby Sangar
faculty.title: Associate Professor
faculty.description: Dr. Ruby Sangar has over 12 years of experience in teaching and research. She completed her Ph.D. in OB and HRM from IIT Roorkee. She has worked with reputed educational universities like JIIT Noida, Symbiosis International University, Noida Campus as Area Chair – HR, BML Munjal University (A Hero Group Initiative), Amity University etc.
